summary: Transuite.Org Inc. (TRSO) filed an 8-K disclosing a September 2, 2026 Letter of Intent to acquire 51% of Zhongke Haichuang (Fujian) Technology Co., Ltd., a China-based Douyin ecosystem ISV, via issuance of TRSO common stock. Valuation, share count, and material terms remain undetermined pending due diligence and definitive agreements, targeted on or before March 31, 2027. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or breakup fee was named. Structural notes: stock consideration creates dilution overhang; minority stake means no full consolidation control; PRC regulatory and cross-border execution risk apply. Watch definitive terms, valuation, and dilution.
